plugins.name: Album filler
plugins.description: Finds the records you own most of and offers you the songs that are missing.
plugins.author: AttackFM

plugins.name: EQ rack
plugins.description: A preset rack for the equalizer: save your own curves, flip between A and B, and land any of them in one tap.
plugins.author: AttackFM

plugins.name: Karaoke Maker
plugins.description: Sing along: a microphone on Now Playing that lifts the vocal out of whatever is playing and puts the words full screen.
plugins.author: AttackFM

plugins.name: Looper
plugins.description: Sample any song into sixteen coloured pads, cut on its own beat, and play the pieces in time with each other.
plugins.author: AttackFM

plugins.name: Pads
plugins.description: Your own records, taken apart and handed back as an instrument: the song keeps playing and the pads decide which parts of it you hear.
plugins.author: AttackFM

plugins.name: Pedals
plugins.description: A pedalboard for your music: fifty-five stompboxes across drive, lo-fi, filter, modulation, time, space and dynamics, wired in the order you stack them.
plugins.author: AttackFM
